routes.name: Entry to the West Bank (via Israeli-controlled crossings)
routes.summary: Entry to the Palestinian Territories is controlled by Israel, so foreign visitors cross through Israeli-run borders under Israeli rules. The general COGAT procedure could not be opened.

other: Check gov.il and COGAT for current rules, which change often. Border officers can refuse entry.

sources.label: gov.il COGAT procedure for Palestinian American citizens

routes.name: ETA-IL arrival permit for Palestinian American citizens
routes.summary: US citizens registered in the Israeli Population Registry as Palestinian residents apply for an ETA-IL, valid two years. At a crossing they usually get a stay permit of up to 90 days. They need a Palestinian ID card and US passport at pedestrian crossings.

stay.note: Usually 90 days, shorter depending on prior entries. ETA valid two years.
